keySource: The key is NYSED's own, read from the Map to the Standards in the released-items PDF and carried into provenance/itemmap_g8-2025.json by tools/extract_item_map.py. tools/merge_content.py re-checks every letter against that file item by item and refuses to build if one disagrees, so the key here cannot drift from the official table or be shifted by one released item. Every constructed-response answer below cites NYSED's own exemplary-response page and is checked against this project's transcription of the same item.

39.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 7 (PDF page 8)
39.check: From negative 18, negative 6 to 6, 6 is 12 up over 24 across. The table is this item's figure.

40.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 12 (PDF page 13)
40.check: A circumference of 17.75 pi is a diameter of 17.75, so the radius is 8.875. The circumference is in this item's own transcribed stem.

41.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 17 (PDF page 18)
41.check: David's table gives a $15 fee and Lisa's equation gives $12. Both are in this item's stem and figure.

42.answer: Rational — the square root of 1.44 is 1.2, a terminating decimal
42.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 22 (PDF page 23)
42.check: 1.2 squared is 1.44, and 1.2 is 12 tenths, a ratio of integers. The radical is this item's own transcribed stem, and it is carried by the vinculum being read as one bar.

43.answer: Function A is linear and Function B is nonlinear
43.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 32 (PDF page 33)
43.check: y = 3x + 8 is in slope-intercept form; y = x squared + 2 is not. Both equations are in this item's own transcribed stem.

44.answer: The speed is constant at 30 miles per hour between 30 and 40 seconds
44.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 42 (PDF page 43)
44.check: That is the horizontal stretch of the graph, where the rate of change is zero. The graph is this item's figure.

45.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 52 (PDF page 53)
45.check: Two thirds of 3x plus 9 is 2x + 6, and 2x + 6 = x minus 4 gives x = minus 10. The equation is this item's own displayed expression.

46.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 62 (PDF page 63)
46.check: Reflecting over the y-axis negates the x coordinate and leaves y, so A at negative 3, 4 becomes 3, 4. A's position is in this item's figure.

47.answer: The student swapped a leg for the hypotenuse: the legs are 3 and 4 and the hypotenuse is 5, so 3 squared plus 4 squared is 5 squared, or 9 + 16 = 25
47.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 72 (PDF page 73)
47.check: The squares drawn on the sides of the triangle give the side lengths, and they are in this item's figure.

48.answer: Mark, at 9 hours a night against Kaley's 7
48.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 82 (PDF page 83)
48.check: Kaley's graph rises 7 hours a night and Mark's table rises 9. Both are in this item's figure and named in its long description.
